types.title: Entry tickets
types.description: Entry types (Adult, Reduced, Child, ...) for equipped free beach and pool: price by period and daily capacity shared with online sales.
types.formHint: The price comes from the pack price list per rate period; the daily capacity is the zone pool, shared with online sales.
types.emptyHint: Create a pack and a quantity zone, then add the types here (Adult, Reduced, Child).
types.inUse: Tickets of this type have already been sold: deactivate it instead of deleting it.
types.codeHint: Short identifier, for example adult. It cannot be changed later.
types.packHint: Pack priced by the price list per period.
types.zoneHint: Quantity zone: its pool is the capacity of the day.
types.activeHint: Only active types appear in the quick sale.

validation.code: Use lowercase letters, digits, hyphens or underscores (max 40)
validation.name: The name in the default language is required

sale.title: Entries
sale.cashHint: An open cash session is required.
sale.full: Capacity sold out for this slot: reduce the quantities or choose another slot.
sale.soldHint: The ticket QR is valid for a single entry.
sale.priceChanged: The price has changed: check the new total and confirm again.
sale.noTypesHint: Set up entry tickets in Configuration.

gate.title: Gate
gate.description: Scan the ticket's QR code with the camera or type its number: one entry per ticket.
gate.unsupported: This browser cannot read QR codes with the camera (iPhone and Firefox included): type the ticket number below.
gate.denied: Camera access denied: allow it in the browser settings or enter the code.
gate.cameraError: Camera not available: enter the code by hand.
gate.manualDescription: Without a camera (iPhone, Firefox) or with an unreadable QR code: type the number printed large on the ticket, or the booking code.
gate.manualHint: The day number is enough (e.g. 37). A manual entry is confirmed by you and recorded in the history.
